scope: UE1 genuine PRD source-policy v14, current cached per-game statistics, and website/JSON read paths. Not a claim of native execution of all game packages or arbitrary mounted-provider selection.

production_cutover.execution: User-provided local PRD Lelly-pc log, independently verified against live PRD read-only UEDB5 and migration-status SQL

root_cause_for_games_page_unavailable.reason: PdoGameCatalogListQuery deliberately rejects cached game statistics when updated_at precedes the last source-correct dependency publication.
root_cause_for_games_page_unavailable.fix: Executed existing catalog/bin/rebuild-game-catalog-stats.php --game-id=<3|12> against PRD MySQL, updating only the two derived aggregate rows. Added auto-refresh in PRD-only scoped UE1 cutover script before final cutover verifier, and made full verifier include game_stats_current.
root_cause_for_games_page_unavailable.interpretation: Zero source-evidenced missing does not mean zero unresolved references. The UE1 source mount order is still not inferred or invented. Official v14 source unresolved remains distinct.

acceptance.full_ue1_verifier_on_PRD_SQL_from_DEV: ue1_cutover_complete=true, game_stats_current=true for game_ids 3 and 12, no stale v14, no old v13; other engines independently unchanged

actual_HTTP_dev_php_prd_database.results: UE1 games.php contains two numeric missing counters per game; no UE1 Unavailable badges. Both JSON endpoints return ok=true, not stale HTTP 409. No stale policy notices and no PHP errors on the tested examiner/fileinfo/filelist pages.

acceptance.stale_guard_fixture: Seven distinct SQLite negative/positive current/stale scenarios passed: correct policy with stale cached timestamp, stats refresh, old v13 policy, mismatched source SHA, newer republished dependency, refresh after publication; full source epoch independent of stats cache.
acceptance.script_validation: PRD-local cutover PowerShell AST parses with zero errors and refresh commands precede final full verifier. PHP linter passes.
acceptance.no_repeated_native_tests: Existing original native UE1 source and table-reader tests accepted in prior evidence reused without reruns.

constraints_and_limits: The genuine local PRD cutover log was supplied by the user. Its final status was independently confirmed by read-only PRD SQL, not by a directly connected PRD Desktop Commander session.
Real PRD web authentication was not exercised; the actual PHP pages were executed using DEV PHP against production read-only MySQL. PRD deployed source hashes will be compared.
Source unresolved provider-selection or native mount order is not reclassified as missing or resolved.
Only existing UE1 native source/readers verified by prior accepted tests are inside this contract; no new UE1 binary payload paths or re-reading texture/mesh/sound was performed.
